title: workshop.txt
description: Project Zomboid Steam Workshop item metadata. Parsed line-by-line as key=value from workshop.txt by SteamWorkshopItem.

version.description: File format version. Always 1. Written by writeWorkshopTxt() but skipped on read.

id.description: Steam Workshop published file ID. A numeric string representing an unsigned 64-bit integer (0 to 18446744073709551615). Validated via SteamUtils.isValidSteamID(). Null/absent until the item is first created on Steam.

title.description: Workshop item title. Single-line, overwrites if repeated. Note: if title is "Mod Template", visibility is forced to private on submit.

description.description: Workshop item description. Multi-line in workshop.txt — lines are concatenated with newline separator. On submit, the game appends "Workshop ID: <id>" and "Mod ID: <modId>" lines automatically.

oneOf.description: Each element becomes a description= line, joined with newlines.

tags.description: Workshop tags. Semicolon-separated in workshop.txt, additive on read (tags.addAll). Allowed values are loaded at runtime from media/WorkshopTags.txt via SteamWorkshopItem.getAllowedTags().

visibility.description: Workshop item visibility. Maps to Steam API integers: public=0, friendsOnly=1, private=2, unlisted=3.

changeNote.description: Change notes for workshop updates. Used during SubmitWorkshopItem() but NOT persisted in workshop.txt. Only used in the submit UI (Page5 changelog).

preview.description: Preview image path (preview.png in the workshop folder). Not a workshop.txt field — it's a file convention. Must be PNG, square (256x256 or 512x512), max 1,024,000 bytes.

file.description: Path to the preview image file.

contentValidation.description: Validation rules for the Contents/ folder, enforced by validateContents().

allowedFolders.description: Only these top-level folders are allowed inside Contents/.

forbiddenFileTypes.description: These file extensions are rejected by validateFileTypes().
